name: Dashboard
description: Summary within your permitted scope
steps: Open Dashboard
Review employee totals and permitted pay summaries
Open your workspace for tasks and requests

name: Employee directory
description: Find visible employees; HR/Admin/Finance can maintain profiles
steps: Open Employees
Search or filter the visible directory
Open an employee for their permitted profile details

ADMIN: Open Employees
Choose Add employee
Enter names, email, job role, manager and start date; set permitted pay fields
Save the employee
CFO: Open Employees
Choose Add employee
Enter names, email, job role, manager and start date; set permitted pay fields
Save the employee
HR: Open Employees
Choose Add employee
Enter names, email, job role, manager and start date; set permitted pay fields
Save the employee

name: Employee profiles
description: Reporting line, permitted pay components, private details and personnel files
steps: Open Employees
Choose an employee
Open the profile section permitted for your role; private-file access is audited

name: Employee CSV import
description: Preview employee changes before committing a CSV
steps: Open Employees then Import
Download the template and choose a CSV
Map columns and choose the duplicate policy
Preview and correct errors before confirming the import

name: Employee portal
description: Role-aware tasks, interviews, requests and workspaces
steps: Open Employee portal
Review your next steps
Choose a workspace and its section

name: Job roles
description: Job titles and suggested pay defaults; not account access
steps: Expand People & finance and open Roles
Choose New job role
Enter the role name and optional suggested pay band/range
Save; the role appears in the list

name: Pay bands
description: Maintain salary bands and assignments
steps: Expand People & finance and open Tiers
Review each band and its permitted totals
Use the Actions arrow for options available to your role

name: Compensation and raises
description: Plan increases and review decisions; HR proposes, Finance approves
steps: Open People & finance then Compensation
Choose Plan raise or Propose raise
Choose people or a band, increase, effective date, cap policy and reason
Preview; authorized Finance/Admin reviewers confirm the decision

name: Finance reports
description: Read and export permitted pay reports
steps: Open People & finance then Reports
Choose the report and any date filters
Review the results and choose Export CSV

name: Accounts and permissions
description: Issue sign-ins and manage login access
steps: Open Administration then Accounts & roles
Choose New account
Enter email, select account permissions and link the employee
Save and securely share the generated credentials once

name: Audit log
description: Read recorded actions without editing them
steps: Open Administration then Audit log
Filter by an exact action when needed
Review actor, time and reference; use pagination

name: Company settings
description: Company formatting and salary visibility defaults
steps: Open Administration then Settings
Review company name, currency, locale and salary-period defaults
Change only intended options and choose Save

name: My pay
description: My pay shows your recorded monthly base plus variable compensation and pay-change history; it does not confirm a bank transfer or generate payslips
steps: Open My pay from Your workspace
Read Your monthly pay and the base plus variable breakdown
Check Your pay history for changes and effective dates; ask HR or Finance about actual payment dates or deductions

name: Personal details
description: Your protected profile; corrections use self-service and Finance
steps: Open Employee portal then Personal details
Reveal your own saved details when needed; account numbers are masked
Request contact corrections through Profile changes and payment corrections through Finance

name: Start attendance
description: Start a server-timed work session
steps: Open Time & attendance
Choose your assigned task or General work
Describe your focus
Choose Start work & mark attendance

name: Finish or switch work
description: Save a work summary/outcome and stop or switch the timer
steps: Open Time & attendance
Choose Finish work or Switch work
Summarize the work and choose In progress, Completed or Blocked
Save to finish; switching also asks for your next task and focus

name: Submit your week
description: Submit recorded hours after finishing sessions
steps: Open Time & attendance and choose the week
Finish any running work session
Expand Week actions and choose Submit my week
Check your hours and confirm; locked weeks require a correction request

name: Attendance reporting
description: Company attendance totals and approved hours export
steps: Open Time & attendance
Choose the week and employee filter
Expand Week actions and choose Export approved hours

name: Approvals and reminders
description: Review requests/timesheets in your scope; no self-approval
steps: Open Approvals
Review the pending request or submitted timesheet
Choose Approve or Reject and enter a reply or reason
Confirm your decision; you cannot approve your own request

name: Raise a workplace concern
description: Use HR help desk for a workplace complaint; this chat does not collect details
steps: Open Employee portal then Self service
Select HR help desk and choose Add HR help desk
Choose Workplace and enter the concern in that protected form
Save and follow the reply in your request

name: Request a private conversation with HR
description: Request an HR conversation through the existing help desk; no automatic calendar booking
keywords: request a private conversation with hr
steps: Open Employee portal then Self service
Select HR help desk and choose Add HR help desk
Request a private conversation with HR in the protected form
Save; HR replies to arrange the conversation

name: Replay a page walkthrough
description: Restart the guided tour for the current page
steps: Open the page you want to learn
Open your profile menu in the top corner
Choose Take the tour again

name: Change your password
description: Account owner changes their own password through the existing form
steps: Open your profile menu
Choose Change password
Enter your current password and the new password confirmation
Save the change yourself
